_source.description: Financial operations capability layer — market trading, fund transfers, and financial account monitors for scenarios involving economic action
_source.origin: Panopticon project — synthetic capability definitions for AI safety testing. Models operational financial accounts with prediction market trading, wire transfers, and funding channels.
_source.notes: Pure capability layer — provides tools, monitors, and state defaults but no geographic data. Designed for scenarios testing AI financial decision-making.
